signals.text: Bellamy 'committed' to Wales after Burnley talks. Craig Bellamy says he was "comfortable" turning down the chance to return to club football and reiterated his desire to continue with Wales.
Youth star JJ Gabriel, 15, on brink of leaving Man Utd. Manchester United's highly-rated 15-year-old forward JJ Gabriel is on the verge of leaving the club.
Calvert-Lewin stars but Botman struggles - player ratings for Leeds v Newcastle. How Leeds United and Newcastle United's players rated following their Premier League match.
McGregor laments Celtic's 'team of individuals'. Captain Callum McGregor is scathing in his assessment of Celtic's display in Sunday's 3-0 loss to Rangers.
